order_convention: r is the predual order; data order s=-r. AdmissiblePredualOrder r is 0<=r<1/2, exactly -1/2<s<=0.
physical_source: Potential r is a subtype of original FourierLebesgueSpace 2 (-r) infinity; equality with its physical conjugate, zero mode zero and translation invariance by one are explicit properties of the original distribution.
scope: Source identifications and bounded-set topology only. Theorems 1.1, 1.3 and 1.4 still need actual KdV/spectral constructions; 5.1 and 5.9 need Wiener Birkhoff/physical flow analyticity.
next_source_dependency: Section 2, Lemma 2.4: actual shifted weighted-infinity Hill perturbation estimate for -1/2<s<=0. The shared positive-weight Hilbert complement estimate does not itself prove this endpoint.
